newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Eurodollars end firm on benign U.S. CPI data.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Eurodollars end firm on benign U.S. CPI data.

text.p: Light follow-through buying after last week's U.S. bond market rally boosted SIMEX Eurodollar futures in an otherwise featureless, holiday-thinned session, dealers said on Monday.

U.S. treasuries surged on Friday after the release of weaker-than expected U.S. consumer inflation and retail sales data for August threw widespread expectations of a short-term interest rate hike into doubt.
The data, coming on the back of a benign August Producer Price Index, confounded predictions the Federal Reserve would raise its funds rate at a policy-making meeting on September 24.
Japanese government bond futures were not traded due to the holiday in Japan. -- Sonali Desai (65-8703090)
